text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Kitasan Black about to head out
with a large group of people and called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now we're all going together
to lend a hand to everyone in the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I usually go by myself,
but today I had so many favors piled up...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Kita-chan was holding back,
so I went ahead and called out to everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you came to me for help.
I'll do my best to pitch in!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Everyone in the shopping district
has been so good to us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm only doing this because it's a favor
for Kitasan and Satono, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And remember, helping me look for herbs is our deal!
Don't you dare forget, or you'll regret it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. So today, we're the helper henchmen
to our chief helper♪
choice_data_list: Then I'll be your helpful sidekick too!
Then, I'll become your helpful lackey too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, even Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Everyone, I'm looking forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Organizing the shed, repotting the bonsai, helping out with deliveries, and checking in on elderly folks living alone—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Kita-chan really is relied upon by everyone, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... But it's really rare to have this many favors asked of me in a single day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you being a little too nice?
Don't blame me if someone takes advantage of you for something really bad~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure everything will be fine.
The shopping district folks are all nice people.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what should we do?
There's quite a lot, so maybe we should split up...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
How about we all have a
'helping contest'?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We're splitting into 3 teams to compete and see who finishes their chores first♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, sounds good!
Heheh, but when it comes to a helping contest, I won't lose!

And so,
Special Week and Grass Wonder,
Satono Diamond and Sweep Tosho—

And so, a helping-out contest began between
three teams including myself and Kitasan Black, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am! I brought out all the beer bottles
in front of the store!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
What's that in your hand?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
A customer forgot it here.
I hope they remember and come back for it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Something a customer left behind...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
I'll go deliver that package!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, time for a quick run!!

Taking on more favors wherever we went,
in the end, it was our team
that was running around until the very finish...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Shrine cleaning complete~.
That's all for today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, it took us this long, so
we're in last place, aren't we...? I'm so sorry."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"What are you even saying?
Kita-chan and her team won first prize!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dia-chan! And everyone else too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it was incredible~! When we went to
help out, everyone said the exact same thing—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Ever since I threw out my back, she carries all the heavy stuff for me. She's such a good kid, really.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
My son and his wife moved overseas with my grandchild, you see.
It gets lonely all by myself, so I'm just so happy whenever you talk to me...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Everrryone was saying it, you knowâhow happy they are that you're here, Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, having only helped out a little for a single day,
we can't hold a candle to Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So after all, today's top prize
goes to Kita-chan and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aww, this is making me kinda blush!
But I'm happy to hear it.
It sounds like I was able to be of help to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To make everyone happy,
I'm gonna try even harder to help out!

Kitasan Black clenches her fist in determination.
A pleasant breeze blew through the shrine,
as if to praise her passionate resolve.
